style.name: Style Atlas #107 Afrofuturism
style.zhName: Style Atlas #107 非洲未来主义
style.description: Afrofuturist editorial design with African diaspora future-tech motifs, solar gold, deep indigo, copper red, geometric textile rhythm, luminous cities, optimistic futurism and a clear grid.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 外交试探、AI震荡与极端天气
zh-CN.headlineView: 同步改写全球风险版图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 外交试探、AI震荡与极端天气；同步改写全球风险版图
zh-CN.intro: 美伊谈判释放缓和信号，亚洲AI芯片股重挫；欧洲山火、美国龙卷风与全球公共卫生议题并行升温。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 市场追逐效率，世界仍要为战争、气候和健康风险留下缓冲。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天的关键词不是一个，是同时发生。

en-US.headlineFact: Diplomatic signals, AI volatility and extreme weather
en-US.headlineFull: Diplomatic signals, AI volatility and extreme weather; redraw the global risk map
en-US.intro: U.S.-Iran talks show signs of easing as Asian AI chip stocks slide; European wildfires, a U.S. tornado and global health gaps intensify.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Markets chase efficiency, but the world still needs buffers for war, climate and health risks.
en-US.doudouQuote: Today has one keyword: everything, everywhere.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 斡旋方称重启美伊谈判取得进展
zh-CN.headlineFull: 斡旋方称重启美伊谈判取得进展；油价随缓和预期回落
zh-CN.intro: 多方正推动双方恢复对话；市场暂时降低海湾供应中断预期，但长期协议仍未落地，后续仍取决于安全安排与执行机制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的降温，要看对话能否变成可执行安排。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 握手还没发生，油价先松了口气。

en-US.headlineFact: Mediators report progress toward restarting talks
en-US.headlineFull: Mediators report progress toward restarting talks; as oil eases
en-US.intro: Efforts are underway to bring both sides back to dialogue; markets lower near-term Gulf supply fears, but no durable deal exists yet.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Real cooling begins when dialogue becomes an executable arrangement.
en-US.doudouQuote: No handshake yet, but oil already exhaled.

zh-CN.headlineFact: AI焦虑引发亚洲科技股抛售
zh-CN.headlineView: 中国竞争与投入回报成焦点
zh-CN.headlineFull: AI焦虑引发亚洲科技股抛售；中国竞争与投入回报成焦点
zh-CN.intro: 亚洲芯片股大跌，投资者担心中国竞争加剧，以及巨额AI支出究竟由谁买单，市场开始重新评估投入回报与估值。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI叙事进入验收期，增长故事必须回答现金流问题。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 算力很快，账单也来得很快。

en-US.headlineFact: AI anxiety hits Asian tech stocks
en-US.headlineView: as competition and returns face scrutiny
en-US.headlineFull: AI anxiety hits Asian tech stocks; as competition and returns face scrutiny
en-US.intro: Asian chip shares fell sharply amid concern over stronger Chinese competition and who will ultimately pay for the AI boom.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI has entered the proof stage; every growth story must answer the cash-flow question.
en-US.doudouQuote: Compute is fast, and so is the bill.

sources.title: AI anxiety sparks tech rout, broad selloff in Asian markets

zh-CN.headlineFact: Creator Match单周撮合百万美元创作者订单
zh-CN.headlineFull: Creator Match单周撮合百万美元创作者订单；小团队平台加速扩张
zh-CN.intro: 这家精简团队运营的B2B创作者平台，一周批准100万美元合作报价，显示AI与自动化正在放大个人和小团队产能。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司不是一个人硬扛，而是用系统把可信交付放大。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 团队可以很小，成交额不必小。

en-US.headlineFact: Creator Match clears $1 million in creator offers
en-US.headlineFull: Creator Match clears $1 million in creator offers; in one week
en-US.intro: The lean B2B creator platform shows how AI and automation can multiply the capacity of individuals and small teams.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A one-person company is not solo struggle; it is a system that scales trusted delivery.
en-US.doudouQuote: The team can stay small while the deals grow.

sources.title: Creator Match founder to speak after a $1 million week

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法国与西班牙山火蔓延
zh-CN.headlineView: 极端高温再次考验欧洲应急系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法国与西班牙山火蔓延；极端高温再次考验欧洲应急系统
zh-CN.intro: 多地消防力量持续处置火情，旅游、交通与居民安全同时承压，持续高温也在增加跨区域救援和公共服务负担。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 气候风险已经从年度议题变成日常运营成本。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 热浪没有边界，烟也不会看国旗。

en-US.headlineFact: Wildfires spread in France and Spain
en-US.headlineView: as extreme heat tests emergency systems
en-US.headlineFull: Wildfires spread in France and Spain; as extreme heat tests emergency systems
en-US.intro: Fire crews battle multiple blazes while tourism, transport and community safety come under pressure.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Climate risk has shifted from an annual topic to a daily operating cost.
en-US.doudouQuote: Heat ignores borders, and smoke skips passports.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 龙卷风袭击威斯康星州东北部
zh-CN.headlineFull: 龙卷风袭击威斯康星州东北部；社区进入灾后评估
zh-CN.intro: 强风暴造成建筑受损并打乱当地生活，应急人员展开搜救和损失核查，社区正同步恢复交通、电力与基本公共服务。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 极端天气下，预警速度和社区韧性同样关键。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：美国极端天气。

en-US.headlineFull: Tornado strikes northeast Wisconsin; as communities assess damage
en-US.intro: Severe storms damaged buildings and disrupted daily life while emergency teams began searches and inspections.
en-US.xiaziQuote: In extreme weather, warning speed and community resilience matter equally.
en-US.doudouQuote: The wind moves fast; mutual aid must move faster.

zh-CN.headlineFull: AIDS 2026警告防治工具更多；但覆盖缺口仍在扩大
zh-CN.intro: 泛美卫生组织称，美洲拥有更多预防、诊断和治疗工具，却仍有大量人群无法公平获得，资源分配和基层覆盖仍是关键短板。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 医疗创新只有抵达需要它的人，才算真正完成。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 工具箱满了，路还不能堵。

en-US.headlineFull: AIDS 2026 says more tools exist; but access gaps persist
en-US.intro: PAHO says the Americas have more prevention, testing and treatment options, yet many people still cannot reach them fairly.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Medical innovation is not complete until it reaches those who need it.
en-US.doudouQuote: A full toolbox is useless if the road is blocked.

sources.title: AIDS 2026 highlights access gaps across the Americas

zh-CN.headlineView: 联合国发起全球行动重申保护承诺
zh-CN.headlineFull: 难民公约75周年；联合国发起全球行动重申保护承诺
zh-CN.intro: 联合国难民署呼吁各国、组织与公众重新承诺保护因战争、暴力和迫害而流离失所的人，并把承诺转化为持续有效的接纳与安置机制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 规则的价值，不在纪念日，而在危机到来时仍然有效。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 七十五岁的承诺，也要天天兑现。

en-US.headlineView: faces a renewed global call to act
en-US.headlineFull: At 75, the Refugee Convention; faces a renewed global call to act
en-US.intro: UNHCR urges governments, organizations and people to recommit to protecting those displaced by war, violence and persecution.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A rule proves its value not on anniversaries, but when crisis arrives.
en-US.doudouQuote: A 75-year-old promise still needs daily delivery.

sources.title: UNHCR launches campaign on Refugee Convention anniversary

zh-CN.headlineFact: 央行决策周遇上能源价格波动
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球利率路径再添不确定性
zh-CN.headlineFull: 央行决策周遇上能源价格波动；全球利率路径再添不确定性
zh-CN.intro: 美联储、日本央行与英国央行的政策预期交织，油价变化继续影响通胀与市场定价，全球资产正重新衡量利率路径与风险溢价。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 能源、通胀和利率是一条链，任何一环变化都会向全球传导。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一桶油打个喷嚏，三家央行都要看温度计。

en-US.headlineFull: Central-bank week meets energy volatility; clouding the global rate path
en-US.intro: Expectations for the Fed, BOJ and Bank of England intersect as oil prices continue to shape inflation and market pricing.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Energy, inflation and rates form one chain; a shift in any link travels globally.
en-US.doudouQuote: When one oil barrel sneezes, three central banks check the thermometer.
